arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs x 1250 m out-and-back, current+wind flips each leg. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (~160-165 W pod; CP pod 158 W test, may be 10-25% off), a little harder on adverse legs, easier on helping legs. Use POD reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) as main gauge. Settle the hard start now. Mid-race: check CP by heart-rate trend at steady effort (measure). Final push from ~1000 m if reserve allows (finish cue ~600-800 m). Watch for incidents: drag change (weed: clear_rudder), pod drift (shaft vs boat power diverge), radio messages (course change: set_race_distance + tell).
